title: POTATO sowing advisory for north india
fertilizer_recommendation: NPK 180:120:100 kg/ha; basal half N + full P + full K; top-dress remaining N at earthing up.
farmer_query: आलू में बुवाई अवस्था पर उत्तर भारत में क्या करें?
farmer_query_en: What should I do at sowing stage of potato in north india?
content: POTATO in north india should follow stage-wise agronomic operations. Sowing window: October-November plains; February-March hills. Seed rate: 2000-2500 kg/ha seed tubers (30-40 g). Spacing: 60 cm x 20-25 cm. Fertilizer: NPK 180:120:100 kg/ha; basal half N + full P + full K; top-dress remaining N at earthing up.. Irrigation: 10-12 light irrigations; avoid waterlogging..
contentHi: उत्तर भारत में आलू के लिए बुवाई अवस्था पर सभी काम समय से करें। बुवाई अवधि October-November plains; February-March hills रखें, बीज दर 2000-2500 kg/ha seed tubers (30-40 g) और दूरी 60 cm x 20-25 cm अपनाएं। उर्वरक प्रबंधन: NPK 180:120:100 kg/ha; basal half N + full P + full K; top-dress remaining N at earthing up.। सिंचाई प्रबंधन: 10-12 light irrigations; avoid waterlogging.।
